hints.title: Modular Duration Buckets
hints.text: The sum of two durations is divisible by 60 if and only if the sum of their remainders modulo 60 is either 0 or 60.

hints.title: Complement Lookup
hints.text: For each duration t with remainder r = t % 60, its required complement remainder is (60 - r) % 60. Check how many times that complement has been observed so far.

hints.title: Single-Pass Tally
hints.text: Iterate through all song lengths with a 60-bucket array. For each item, add the count of its complement to the total, then increment the count for its own remainder bucket.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numPairsDivisibleBy60(self, time: list[int]) -> int:
        count = [0] * 60
        res = 0
        for t in time:
            r = t % 60
            res += count[(60 - r) % 60]
            count[r] += 1
        return res
```

variables: N: number of songs in time array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every pair of songs directly takes O(N^2) time, which is too slow for 60,000 items.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using a fixed-size 60-element array consumes constant auxiliary storage and reduces running time to linear.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as two-sum with modular arithmetic using a 60-element frequency array.
